title: Tight Formulations for Unit Commitment with Different Levels of Details -- Part I: Models and Theoretical Insights
summary: The unit commitment (UC) problem is paramount for optimal operation of power systems, but it faces computational limitations in large-scale settings, especially in investment or stochastic models, because of the binary variables that it contains. A lot of research has attempted to improve the computational performance of UC models, either by reducing model size, resulting in lower fidelity and accuracy, or by improving the tightness of the formulation.
